Bibliotecas copiadas para o app funcionar sem CDN.
- three 0.170.0 (MIT): build/three.module.min.js e examples/jsm (CSS3DRenderer, RoundedBoxGeometry, RectAreaLightUniformsLib/TexturesLib, BufferGeometryUtils)
- gsap 3.12.5 (licença padrão GreenSock, uso gratuito): dist/gsap.min.js
- three addons extras (MIT): objects/Reflector, postprocessing (EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass, ShaderPass, MaskPass, Pass), shaders (Copy, LuminosityHighPass, Output)
- three addons (MIT): environments/RoomEnvironment
- three addons (MIT) para o Vetor3D: controls/OrbitControls, loaders/GLTFLoader, exporters/GLTFExporter
